LESSON: FOODS/FEEDING PRACTICES

Grade: PP1
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: HEALTH
Topic 2.5: Foods/Feeding PRACTICES

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Foods/Feeding PRACTICES
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: How do we eat?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. tell the importance of eating food • they eat at home and school 5. Why should we use

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Foods/Feeding PRACTICES

Teach
• Observe Foods/Feeding PRACTICES in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• tell the importance of eating food • they eat at home and school 5. Why should we use

SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Foods/Feeding PRACTICES.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Foods/Feeding PRACTICES: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How do we eat?
2. Why do we eat clean (10 Lessons) • Learners to be guided in telling food?
3. Why do we eat food?
4. How should we behave eating clean food talk about foods when eating?

SECTION: REMEMBER
